component.name: Polifonia
component.summary: Multi-Speaker and Multi-Monitor Audio Unison Engine for Linux

description.p: Polifonia is an advanced, PipeWire-native multi-speaker audio compositing, synchronization, and acoustic DSP management system for Linux desktops.

It enables workstations with heterogeneous audio setups (HDMI or DisplayPort integrated screen speakers, USB audio DACs, S/PDIF optical receivers, Bluetooth A2DP speakers, smart speakers, network/AirPlay sinks, and auxiliary subwoofers) to aggregate disparate physical outputs into a unified, phase-aligned, frequency-filtered multichannel virtual soundstage.

ul.li: Universal hardware discovery for HDMI/DP displays, USB DACs, S/PDIF, Bluetooth A2DP, and Network/AirPlay sinks
Two-level hardware-agnostic synchronization: real-time PipeWire SPA telemetry plus closed-loop microphone Auto-Sync using FFT Hilbert analytic cross-correlation
Active 4th-order Linkwitz-Riley (24 dB/oct) acoustic crossover DSP, audiophile resampling, and 180-degree phase inversion
Interactive Cairo live routing graph and studio mixing console UI built with GTK4 and Libadwaita
System tray companion indicator for quick volume control and unison toggle

description.p: Added hardware-agnostic closed-loop acoustic Auto-Sync (FFT Hilbert analytic cross-correlation and sub-sample parabolic interpolation), real-time PipeWire ProcessLatency telemetry, 4th-order Linkwitz-Riley crossover, 180-degree phase inversion, and S/PDIF and Network sink support.
Standardized project naming to Polifonia, added AppStream metadata and Flathub distribution support.
Added device bus detection, latency estimation, and custom labeling UI for audio sinks.
